title: coussarea albescens
intro: Coussarea albescens, commonly known as White Coussarea, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
